reasoning: This icon depicts a standard 'rewind 5 seconds' media player control (counterclockwise circular arrow around the number 5). Because it is specialized playback interface chrome representing a specific increment rather than a real-world task subject, it has almost no use in a general to-do list outside of building a media player, and is easily confused with other rewind/undo glyphs at small sizes.
